$comment: AUTHORITATIVE framework-source registry. Consumed by scripts/ci/check_licensing.py. Deny by default: content whose licensing state is not recorded here as BUNDLED_OPEN does not enter the public repository, the export, the packages or the SBOM. An empty `sources` list is the correct state today and is NOT a pass by omission - the gate separately proves that no framework content exists anywhere in the tree.

dispositions.BUNDLED_OPEN: Redistribution and commercial use verified in writing. May ship in the public repository and packages.
dispositions.REFERENCE_ONLY: May be named and cited. Content is NOT reproduced or bundled.
dispositions.PRIVATE_RESEARCH_ONLY: Owner may study it privately. Never enters the public export, packages, SBOM, fixtures or docs.
dispositions.LICENSE_REQUIRED: Distribution needs a provider agreement that does not yet exist.
dispositions.PROHIBITED: Determined not redistributable by ISEDRAF under any current model.
dispositions.UNDER_REVIEW: Licensing not yet established. Treated as PROHIBITED until it is.

$sources_comment: No third-party framework source has been reviewed, registered or bundled. This is the accurate state of the project on 2026-09-19, not a placeholder awaiting content.
